ideas.idea: SmartMoving-native outbound lead engine for independent moving companies
ideas.traction: $7,615 MRR from 8 active subscriptions (TrustMRR snapshot at time of research)
ideas.customer: Independent US residential moving companies using SmartMoving, roughly 2–10 trucks, one metro
ideas.wedge: SmartMoving-native lead delivery + smaller exclusive ZIP territories + done-for-you onboarding
ideas.why: High ARPU, tiny required customer count, identifiable buyers, direct-sales friendly, licensable inputs, measurable ROI
ideas.risk: The listing-to-booked-move conversion may be too weak to sustain repeatable ROI; incumbent could add the same integration wedge
